title: Intergraph CLIX workstation, late 1980s
credit: Gigs, Wikimedia Commons contributor; released into the public domain.
altText: An Intergraph CLIX workstation with a monitor, keyboard and console.
caption: An Intergraph CLIX workstation from the late 1980s, photographed when it was decommissioned in the late 1990s.
context: The photographer identifies this as a late-1980s workstation and says it was photographed during decommissioning in the late 1990s. Its location and use are not identified, so it is included as representative period equipment and not as a New Zealand GIS installation.
